generic_domain.justification: Generative networks is the most general and comprehensive research domain because it encapsulates all the listed domains. This includes generative adversarial networks (GANs), which use competition between two neural networks to generate data. It also covers generative flow networks, such as Normalizing Flows, which model complex distributions using invertible functions. Additionally, generative networks encompass deep generative models, a broader category that relies on deep learning techniques for generating data. Overall, 'generative networks' serves as the umbrella term that unifies all these specialized areas under its scope.
